---
title: "Resume and share results"
output: html_document
---

Use the saved batch when execution was interrupted or when reports need to be regenerated.

## Resume validation

Replace the path below with the batch directory created during planning.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
library(ros.form.validation)
batch <- "output/ros-validation-2026-10-20T120000Z" # Your existing batch
plan <- read_ros_validation_plan(batch)
validate_ros_plan(plan)
reports <- write_ros_reports(plan)
publication <- build_ros_publication(plan)
```

Completed results are reused after checksum verification. Resume does not add new inputs to the plan.

Run only the stages still needed. An existing report or publication directory is not overwritten by default.

A saved failed result is also a completed result. After correcting inputs or references, create a new batch plan.

## Refresh report presentation

Use this after updating report presentation code, when the validation results themselves are unchanged.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
reports <- write_ros_reports(plan, overwrite = TRUE)
publication <- build_ros_publication(
  plan,
  output = file.path("output", paste0("review_", basename(batch)))
)
```

Choose a new publication directory. This keeps your previous prepared copy available for comparison.

Report regeneration does not apply new validation rules. Rule changes require a new validation batch.

For the dedicated `ros.ultreia.io` uploader, keep the default `aggregated_<batch>` name instead of `review_<batch>`.

## Preview locally

```{r, eval=FALSE}
install.packages("servr") # Once
servr::httd(dir = publication, browser = TRUE)
```

Keep R running while browsing. Stop the preview with `servr::daemon_stop()` when finished.

## Share the prepared folder

Give your web operator the entire prepared publication folder, preserving its directories and filenames.

The server must serve HTML, CSV, JSON and shared assets over HTTP, with `index.html` as the directory default page.

Share the resulting root URL with reviewers. They can navigate down to each form and back through the breadcrumbs.

Keep the raw batch locally for future report regeneration. It contains the saved plan, references and validation results.

Uploading to the existing private ROS site is an operator task described in [Command-line operation](operator-workflow.html).
